text:
maya: Hey — pushed a follow-up to narrow the e2e flake. I removed the implicit timer dependency and added a retry with jitter. tests pass locally for me (mac / linux). can someone re-review the error-path changes when you have a sec?

maya: diff snippet: ```diff
-    sleep(100)
+    await backoff_retry(asyncFn, {retries: 3, jitter: true})
```

maya: run locally: `./scripts/run-e2e --filter=timeout_handling --repeat=20`

ci-bot: CI: re-run requested by maya — triggered workflow `e2e/smoke` on branch `fix/e2e-timer` (job queued)

sam: looking now. quick q: do you want this squashed before merge or keep the intermediate cleanup commits? also planning canary windows later today, ping if you want a slot.

maya: I think squash makes sense (the intermediate commits were exploratory). happy to rebase/squash if everyone prefers that.

lee: minor ask: can we run the lightweight perf harness against the change? last time timer tweaks changed p95 on the path. if perf is within 1% I'm fine.

maya: ran the perf harness against staging (10 runs):
```
baseline p95: 120ms
this branch p95: 121ms (+0.8%)
median delta: +0.3%
error rate: unchanged
```

maya: Given that, I think it's safe. Also added a small unit test exercising the retry backoff.

sam: thanks — that perf delta is fine. LGTM from my side. :thumbsup: I'll take merge custody and schedule a small canary at 16:00 UTC unless anyone objects.

lee: +1 from me, no objections.

deploy-bot: Canary slot booked by sam for `fix/e2e-timer` at 2026-03-20T16:00:00Z. Reminder 15m pre-check at 15:45 UTC.

maya: awesome — thanks both. I'll squash the branch now and push, then @sam you can merge when ready.

sam: got it, will merge after the squash and CI green.

maya: thanks :pray:
